_about: Messages v2 Stage 5 wording corpus: 30 seller situations x 10 wordings. Seller wordings are TEST DATA authored for the harness (they are what a homeowner might text, not Sandra's words). The openers (our_last_text) are the synthetic fixture openers from src/lib/sms-classification/__fixtures__/nine-questions-matrix.json and real masked openers from .planning/messages-v2/REPLAY-NINE-QUESTIONS.md with [name]/[address] filled in. No question text, reply text or drip text is defined here: the harness imports those from the product.
_expected_rule: expected_buckets follow the precedence in code: up-front non-price keyword gate (dispatch.ts step 2) > hostile wording or hostile answer > asked_stop > wrong_person > hot (talked_price / open_to_selling, or any other answer yielding to a price keyword) > maybe_later > not_interested > asked_who > confirmed_owner > needs_person; responder off for the property = nothing at all. Group order and cutoff come from src/lib/sms-classification/nine-questions.ts (Jarrad, memory note jev-approved-questions).
